movie.title: Moana
movie.overview: In Ancient Polynesia, when a terrible curse incurred by Maui reaches an impetuous Chieftain's daughter's island, she answers the Ocean's call to seek out the demigod to set things right.

facts: Did you know the big terrible curse that kicks off Moana's adventure was actually *incurred* by the demigod Maui himself? Talk about creating your own problems!
Our brave hero, Moana, isn't just any protagonist; she's specifically described as an 'impetuous Chieftain's daughter.' This gives us a fun insight into her spirited nature right away.
Moana doesn't just decide to go on a quest; she actually *answers the Ocean's call* directly! This unique connection is what truly drives her to seek out the demigod and restore balance.
